cases.source:
flowchart TD
  A["日本語😀 start"] --> B["end 👍🏽"]
cases.note: Japanese and emoji (astral code points, a ZWJ-free skin tone sequence) before later text: offsets must be UTF-16 code units
Emoji and Japanese in pie labels
`e1@{ ... }` is an edge attribute line, not a node
cases.futureBehaviour: Treat the line as opaque or recognised edge metadata; never create a node `e1`; refuse edits that connect to it

cases.source:
flowchart TD
  A@{ shape: rounded, label: "x" } --> B
cases.note: `A@{ shape, label }`: the label lives in the attribute block
cases.futureBehaviour: Rename / delete must edit or keep the attribute block together with the node; otherwise refuse

cases.source:
flowchart TD
  A --> B; C --> D
  B --> E
  linkStyle 2 stroke:red
cases.note: A line holding two statements is opaque, yet it contains an edge, so the `linkStyle` index depends on it
cases.futureBehaviour: Refuse any edit that adds, removes or reorders edges while an opaque line contains an edge and `linkStyle` exists

cases.source:
flowchart TB
  subgraph one
    A --> B
  end
  one --> C
cases.note: A subgraph id used as an edge endpoint is not a node
cases.futureBehaviour: Never report `one` as a node; keep the edge intact

cases.source:
flowchart TB
  subgraph one
    A --> B
  end
  B --> C
cases.note: Deleting node `A` must not change which subgraph `B` belongs to
cases.futureBehaviour: Semantic check: subgraph membership of untouched nodes is identical before and after

cases.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A
  participant B
  A<<->>B: two
  A<<-->>B: three
cases.note: `<<->>` / `<<-->>` are arrows, not participants named `A<<`
cases.futureBehaviour: Recognise as messages or keep opaque; never create a phantom participant

cases.source:
sequenceDiagram
  A->>+B: call
  B-->>-A: ret
cases.note: `+` / `-` activate and deactivate; moving or deleting one side breaks rendering (inactive participant)
cases.futureBehaviour: Treat activation pairs as one unit or refuse edits that touch either message

cases.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A
  participant B
  A->>B: hi
  B-->>A: yo
cases.note: The last line has no terminator; a delete reaching the end of the text produced overlapping edits in the reference tool
cases.futureBehaviour: Edits that remove the last line must still apply (or be refused with a reason), never throw

cases.source:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  T :t1, 2024-01-01, 2d
  click t1 href "https://example.com"
cases.note: `click` is an interaction line, not a task
cases.futureBehaviour: Keep the line opaque; never count it as a task

cases.source:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  A :a1, 2024-01-01, 2d
  B :2d
cases.note: `B` has no start and implicitly follows `A`; deleting `A` changes B's date
cases.futureBehaviour: Refuse the delete, or make the dependency explicit as a visible, confirmed edit

cases.source:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section S
  T :t1, notadate, 3d
cases.note: mermaid.parse accepts it, but rendering fails
cases.futureBehaviour: Validity is decided by rendering (the render gate), never by parse alone
